name: Poster / folded field
rule: One statement in the reserve of the fold. The valleys run behind the type, never through the word.

name: Poster / solid ember
rule: Full-strength ember at 100%. The mark is the only other element; scale it independently of the headline.

name: Poster series / three materials
rule: Same type position, same mark position, three different materials. The system is the constant; the material is the variable.

name: Out-of-home / landscape
rule: A statement at the left, a body at the right. Read distance is long: one line, no small copy except the signature.

name: Type poster / line screen
rule: Paper, one ink, one pitch. The screen carries the field; the black type carries the message.

name: Brand / textured Hello
rule: Grain in the ink, a separate field behind it. The word stays live SVG text; edit it in the text field.

name: Social / story
rule: Interface chrome stays quiet. Headline inside the safe area; the bottom band belongs to the mark and the action.

name: Social / feed
rule: The message reads at thumbnail size. Interface and caption stay outside the artwork.

name: Social / carousel
rule: Three frames, one idea. Material → solid → paper: the sequence moves from atmosphere to statement to detail.

name: Social / profile
rule: Vary material and scale; repeat the type hierarchy and the mark position across the grid.

name: Deck / opening
rule: 16:9, one central statement. The tube crosses the frame once and the rail carries context, never a paragraph.

name: Deck / section divider
rule: A number, a title, a body. The eclipse is the counter-form; nothing else competes with it.

name: Deck / capabilities
rule: Four comparable groups. Rules and white space first; illustration only if it adds evidence.

name: Strategy / amplification
rule: Every node has a role. The path back to the central outcome stays visible; color distinguishes channels.

name: Document / report cover
rule: The screen is the cover; the title block is solid. Nothing sits over the halftone except the mark.

name: Editorial / spread
rule: Left page is the material, right page is the argument. Body text never crosses the gutter; folios sit on the outer corners.

name: Document / working brief
rule: Write the decision before the detail. Owner, constraints, source of truth, and acceptance stay visible.

name: Document / evidence spread
rule: Separate the evidence from the interpretation. The visual supports the finding; it never stands in for it.

name: Print / correspondence
rule: Physical framing is presentation only. Card and letterhead are flat, editable layouts with exact marks.

name: Website / hero
rule: Navigation and text stay in the DOM. The lens refracts the field; it never obstructs editing.

name: Product / app screen
rule: Material only in the header band. Lists, controls and small type sit on a stable dark surface with navy dividers.

name: Motion / title frame
rule: The light moves slowly behind stationary, legible type. Respect reduced motion and provide a pause control.
